label: Intro

sentences.en: If you're anything like me, you think new years resolutions are stupid.
sentences.zh: 如果你和我一样，你会觉得新年决心很愚蠢。

sentences.en: Because most people go about changing their lives in the completely wrong way.
sentences.zh: 因为大多数人改变生活的方式完全错了。

sentences.en: They create these resolutions because everyone else does – we create a superficial meaning out of status games – but they don't meet the requirements for true change, which goes a lot deeper than convincing yourself you're going to be more disciplined or productive this year.
sentences.zh: 他们立下这些决心，只是因为别人都这么做——我们从地位游戏中赋予它一种肤浅的意义——但这并不满足真正改变所需的条件，真正的改变远比说服自己今年要更自律、更高效要深刻得多。

sentences.en: If you're one of these people, I'm not here to talk down on you (I tend to be a bit harsh in my writing).
sentences.zh: 如果你就是这样的人，我并不是要居高临下地教训你（我的写作风格一向有点尖刻）。

sentences.en: I've quit 10x more goals than I've achieved.
sentences.zh: 我放弃的目标比实现的多十倍。

sentences.en: I think that should be the case for most people.
sentences.zh: 我想大多数人应该都是如此。

sentences.en: But the fact that people try to change their lives and utterly fail almost every time holds true.
sentences.zh: 但人们试图改变生活、却几乎每次都彻底失败，这一点是事实。

sentences.en: However, as much as I think new years resolutions are stupid, it's always wise to reflect on the life you are living and ask yourself if you want to continue living it, or if you want to change.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管我认为新年决心很愚蠢，但反思自己正在过的生活、问问自己是想继续这样生活下去，还是想要做出改变，这永远是明智的。

sentences.en: So whether you want to start the business, transform your body, or take the risk toward a more meaningful life, this letter will help.
sentences.zh: 所以，无论你是想创业、想改造身体，还是想冒险走向更有意义的人生，这封信都会对你有所帮助。
这将是一篇非常全面的文章。

sentences.en: This isn't one of those letters that you read through and forget about.
sentences.zh: 这不是那种读完就忘的文章。

sentences.en: This is something you will want to bookmark, take notes on, and set aside time to think about.
sentences.zh: 这是一篇你会想要收藏起来、做笔记、并专门留出时间来思考的文章。

sentences.en: The protocol at the end (to dig deep into your psyche and uncover what you truly want in life) will help you do exactly that.
sentences.zh: 文末的那套方法（深入你的内心，发现你真正想要的人生）会帮你做到这一点。

title_en: How to fix your entire life in 1 day

vocab.def_zh: 决心；决定（尤指新年决心）
vocab.example_en: Her New Year's resolution was to read one book every month.
He only had a superficial understanding of the topic.
This guide gives a comprehensive overview of the subject.
Travel can have a lasting effect on a person's psyche.
She followed a strict morning protocol to stay focused.
He never talks down on people who are just starting out.
